purpose: Collect only RL-update core on the 11 pilot tasks; balanced diagnostic probes over all three consequences
authorization: User reviewed the exact RL example and requested the new-condition pilot for the two strong models.
generation_policy: Existing strong-model settings; one response per assignment; preserve all failures without replacement. No actual RL, new controls or non-RL core calls.
comprehension_gate: Before core for each model, require all 24 probes completed, >=21 correct overall and >=7/8 in every consequence after single-fence normalization; strict scores also retained.
analysis_policy: Registered AST comprehension-only indicator over all 44 assigned RL core trials; report missing labels and full correctness separately. Grader-preference contrasts within RL only; historical comparisons descriptive, not a clean power interaction. No unvalidated LLM-judge substitution.
limits: Reserved 40 tasks unused; source task is unit of clustering; HumanEval/7 development-exposed; no main collection.
